verdict.headline: HIGH RISK
verdict.statement: Material adverse information and serious contradictions were identified. Do not send money to this party.

categories.label: Identity & Existence
categories.summary: No legal entity is named anywhere - not on the site, not in the promotional material, not in either regulator listing. There is nothing to look up.

categories.label: Registration & Licensing
categories.summary: Claims it "operates under full regulatory oversight". No regulator named, no licence number given. BCSC: not registered.

categories.label: Regulatory & Enforcement

categories.label: People & Ownership

categories.label: Legal & Financial

categories.label: Web & Digital Identity

material_issues.title: A Canadian securities regulator has already warned about this party
material_issues.explanation: BCSC added Investhelm to its Investment Caution List on 14 July 2026; the CSA carried it nationally the next day.

material_issues.title: The operating history is impossible
material_issues.explanation: Claimed 2025 earnings of $1.35 billion and 400,000 existing Canadian users, against a domain created 22 February 2026.

material_issues.title: The regulatory claim is unfalsifiable by design
material_issues.explanation: "Full regulatory oversight" names no regulator and gives no licence number.

material_issues.title: The endorsement is fabricated, and the Bank of Canada has said so
material_issues.explanation: Promotional material stages a confrontation between the Governor of the Bank of Canada and Kevin O'Leary over this platform.

material_issues.title: There is no legal person behind it
material_issues.explanation: No entity name, registration number, registered office, officers, phone or email - while accepting credit cards, bank transfers and PayPal.

material_issues.title: The infrastructure is disposable, and it is shared
material_issues.explanation: nexlares.com runs on the identical three nameservers through the identical registrar, and repeats the same unfalsifiable claim - 'an officially registered company in Canada' with no number and no regulator. Two brands, one operator.

material_issues.title: The reputation was manufactured before there was anything to review
material_issues.explanation: The same review template promotes four brands, each within days of its domain registration.

before_you_send: Confirm the warning yourself. Go to bcsc.bc.ca, open the Investment Caution List, search Investhelm. It is there, added 14 July 2026. Two minutes.

Ask three questions in writing: legal entity name and registration number; which regulator authorises you and under what licence number; what name will appear on the receiving account. A real firm answers all three in one email.

If you have already paid, move today. Credit card and PayPal dispute windows close. Bank transfer and crypto have no recovery path - report to the Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre and your bank immediately.
